subject: HelixPay: sudden request saturation causing 429s and high latency
messages:
From: Alice Turner <alice@helixpay.com>
To: connor_obrien <connor@redwood.com>
Cc: HelixPay SRE <sre@helixpay.com>
Date: 2026-05-05T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Production: sudden 429s and latency spike impacting payment auths

Connor —

We're seeing a massive spike in 429s and 600-900ms tail latency for payment authorization calls from our integration starting ~07:55 PDT. Impact: ~15% failed auths, customer-facing timeouts. Our engineers captured a brief metrics dump (attached) and the requests look like a tight burst of small payload auth requests from a single key.

Key details:
- First observed: 2026-05-05 07:55 PDT
- Error: 429 (rate_limited) + elevated 95/99 pct latency
- Affected endpoint: /v1/generate (model: rdx-large-2)
- Impact: auth timeouts -> consumer payments delayed

We urgently need you to confirm whether any rate-limiting/quota changes or policy rollouts were applied in the last hour that would explain automatic throttling. If you can open a support ticket (or patch a temporary rule) that would be appreciated — this is causing live user impact.

Attached: metrics-snapshot-20260505.png (heatmap + 1m QPS series)

Thanks,
Alice Turner
Head of Integrations — HelixPay

From: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: connor_obrien <connor@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-05T08:36:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Production: sudden 429s and latency spike impacting payment auths

Connor / team — quick triage update (SRE oncall):

Summary of findings so far:
- We see a ~2000 QPS microburst from a single HelixPay API key between 07:54 - 07:58 PDT.
- The tenant's burst-credit budget was exhausted quickly due to our burst accounting using a 1-minute refill window; the safety valve engaged and began returning 429s once credits hit zero.
- There was a policy rollout earlier this morning (06:45 PDT) that tightened cross-tenant burst sharing for rdx-large-2 nodes in us-west-2; the rollout didn't target HelixPay specifically but changed the effective burst headroom.
- Additionally, HelixPay's client retried aggressively (exponential-backoff misconfigured to near-zero) — amplification effect.

Immediate mitigation we applied (08:30 PDT):
- Temporarily increased HelixPay's burst allowance by +150% on the serving tier to clear the backlog (manual override).
- Enabled model fallback routing for the integration key to an identical-capacity pool with looser burst limits while we stabilize.

Next steps (recommended):
1) Engineering: revert the policy rollout (or patch the rollout) that reduced cross-tenant sharing and push a refined burst-window (move from 60s to 30s refill for this tenant) — target: 2 hours.
2) Product/SRE: update documentation for tenant isolation behavior and add a guardrail to prevent 0-backoff retry configs from amplifying microbursts.
3) Sales/Support: offer HelixPay a service credit for the window of impact and coordinate a postmortem meeting.

Attachments: config-diff-helixpay.patch (proposed policy delta), metrics-snapshot-20260505.png

I can stay on a bridge if you want to loop HelixPay in directly.

— Stephanie
Engineering Oncall — Redwood Inference

I'll prepare a 1-slide exec summary for the CTO and CRO; Connor, can you coordinate the customer message and confirm the level of credit we should offer?

Marissa Cole

From: connor_obrien <connor@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-05-05T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Production: sudden 429s and latency spike impacting payment auths — immediate status and next steps

Alice — thanks again for the report and the attached heatmap. Quick status update and what we've done: 

What happened (short): a microburst from a single HelixPay key exhausted burst credits under a recently-adjusted sharing policy; safety valve then returned 429s while our automated retry behavior amplified the spike.

What we did (so far):
- SRE temporarily increased HelixPay's burst allowance and routed traffic to an alternative pool (08:30 PDT) to reduce immediate errors.
- We have a hotfix (config-diff-helixpay.patch) staged to revert the sharing change for your tenant; target deployment in ~90 minutes after smoke tests.
- We're also recommending you adjust client-side retry backoffs to prevent amplification; our SDK team can help.

Customer-facing remedies and ask:
- We will issue a credit for the impacted window (pending finance approval). I will open the billing request now and loop you in.
- Proposed follow-up: 1-hour postmortem with SRE + product + your SRE team to review runbook and retry behavior. My proposed time: 2026-05-05 14:00 PDT. Confirm if that works.

Links and ticket: SUP-12345 (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SUP-12345) — I'll update with minutes and watch the smoke tests.

Apologies for the disruption. We'll follow up with a formal postmortem and the permanent fix.

Connor O'Brien
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: SUP-12345 link, metrics snapshot (from HelixPay), proposed config patch
